name: Do I Know You?
source:
Do I Know You? is a very short visual novel about a man visiting his mother with dementia.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《我認識你嗎？》是一部很短的視覺小說，講述一個男人探望患有失智症的母親的故事。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624690/]Steam[/url]］
